## Checklist

- [ ] `changes/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md` added, with the owner, contributors and **AI use** filled in (or "None.")
- [ ] A `decisions/` file for each decision made
- [ ] `learnings/` or `knowledge/` notes for anything the team should remember (one idea per file)
- [ ] The plan in `plans/` updated (`Done when` boxes ticked, `Log` line added)
- [ ] `python3 scripts/index.py` run (CI fails if an index is stale)
- [ ] Tested, including failure cases; how to check is in the `changes/` file
- [ ] No secrets, student IDs, personal data or `.env` in the diff
